insert-page-range-into-pdf.title: Insert Page Range from One PDF into Another Using Streams
insert-page-range-into-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading source and destination PDFs from file streams, validating a page range, and inserting those pages into a specific position in the destination document using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-selected-pages-into-pdf.title: Insert Selected Pages from One PDF into Another
insert-selected-pages-into-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading two PDFs, selecting specific pages from a source file, and inserting them into a destination PDF at a given position using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-specific-pages-into-pdf.title: Insert Selected PDF Pages at a Specific Position
insert-specific-pages-into-pdf.description: Demonstrates opening PDFs as streams, selecting specific pages from a source PDF, and inserting them into a destination PDF at a defined page index using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-pdf-pages-at-beginning.title: Insert PDF Pages at Beginning of Another PDF
insert-pdf-pages-at-beginning.description: Demonstrates how to load two PDF documents and insert all pages from a source PDF at the start of a destination PDF using Aspose.Pdf's page collection API.

insert-pages-into-middle-of-pdf.title: Insert PDF Pages at Middle Position Using Aspose.Pdf
insert-pages-into-middle-of-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to insert all pages from a source PDF into the middle of a destination PDF using Aspose.Pdf's Document and PageCollection APIs.

append-pages-to-pdf.title: Append Pages from One PDF to Another
append-pages-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load two PDF files with Aspose.Pdf, append all pages from a source document to the end of a destination document, and save the merged result.

insert-pages-into-pdf-in-memory.title: Insert Pages from One PDF into Another In-Memory
insert-pages-into-pdf-in-memory.description: Shows how to create PDFs entirely in memory, insert all pages from a source document into a destination document at a specific position, and save the merged PDF to a MemoryStream using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-insert-page-ranges.title: Batch Insert Page Ranges from Multiple PDFs
batch-insert-page-ranges.description: Demonstrates merging specific page ranges from several source PDF files into a single destination PDF by inserting pages sequentially with Aspose.Pdf.

append-pages-from-multiple-pdfs.title: Insert Pages from Multiple PDFs Using Ranges
append-pages-from-multiple-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to merge pages from several source PDFs into a single document by specifying page ranges for each source file.

load-pdf-and-save-with-aspose-pdf.title: Load PDF and Extract First Page
load-pdf-and-save-with-aspose-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF file, obtaining its page count with the Document class, and extracting a specific page using PdfFileEditor.

load-pdf-and-save-copy.title: Insert PDF into Another PDF Using PdfFileEditor
load-pdf-and-save-copy.description: Shows how to load a destination PDF, retrieve the page count of a source PDF, and insert all source pages at the beginning of the destination PDF, saving the merged result.

insert-pages-into-pdf-and-save.title: Insert a Page from One PDF into Another
insert-pages-into-pdf-and-save.description: Demonstrates loading two PDFs with Aspose.Pdf, inserting a page from the source document into the destination document, and saving the result to a new file.

rotate-pdf-page-save-to-memorystream.title: Add Text Stamp to PDF and Save to MemoryStream
rotate-pdf-page-save-to-memorystream.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a file into a MemoryStream, applying a text stamp watermark, and saving the modified document back to a MemoryStream without touching the file system.

split-pdf-from-first-to-end-page.title: Extract First N Pages from PDF
split-pdf-from-first-to-end-page.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, copy pages 1 through a specified end page into a new document, and save the extracted pages to a separate file.

split-pdf-from-first-page-to-end-page.title: Split PDF from First Page to Specified End Page In-Memory
split-pdf-from-first-page-to-end-page.description: Demonstrates how to split a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor, extracting pages 1 through a given end page entirely in memory via streams.

split-pdf-into-bulk-page-sets.title: Split PDF into Bulk Page Sets Using Streams
split-pdf-into-bulk-page-sets.description: Shows how to split an input PDF stream into multiple smaller PDFs, each containing up to a specified number of pages, and return the results as an array of MemoryStream objects.

split-pdf-from-page-to-end.title: Extract PDF Pages from Start Page to End
split-pdf-from-page-to-end.description: Shows how to split a PDF by extracting all pages from a given start page to the end of the document using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor.

split-pdf-from-start-to-end.title: Split PDF from Start Page to End Using Streams
split-pdf-from-start-to-end.description: Shows how to extract pages from a given start page to the last page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor and return the result as a MemoryStream.

split-pdf-into-individual-pages.title: Split PDF into Individual Page PDFs
split-pdf-into-individual-pages.description: Shows how to split a multi‑page PDF into separate one‑page PDF files using Aspose.Pdf's Document class and page collection methods.

split-pdf-into-individual-page-pdfs.title: Split PDF into Single-Page PDFs Using MemoryStream
split-pdf-into-individual-page-pdfs.description: Shows how to split a PDF into separate one-page PDF files by cloning each page into a new Document, saving it to a MemoryStream, and writing the stream to disk.

split-pdf-into-single-page-pdfs.title: Split PDF into Single-Page PDFs Using MemoryStream
split-pdf-into-single-page-pdfs.description: The example splits a PDF into individual pages using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.SplitToBulks, obtains each page as a MemoryStream, and writes them to uniquely named PDF files.

concatenate-split-pdfs.title: Concatenate Split PDFs into a Single Document
concatenate-split-pdfs.description: Shows how to merge multiple PDF files (e.g., split pages) into one PDF by inserting each source document's pages into a target document using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-front-part-pdf-splitfromfirst.title: Extract First N Pages from PDF using SplitFromFirst
extract-front-part-pdf-splitfromfirst.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.SplitFromFirst to extract pages from the beginning of a PDF up to a specified end page and save them as a new document.

extract-front-pages-splitfromfirst-strea.title: Extract First N Pages In-Memory Using SplitFromFirst
extract-front-pages-splitfromfirst-strea.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.SplitFromFirst with streams to extract pages 1 through a specified end page entirely in memory, without creating temporary files.

split-pdf-into-multiple-page-ranges.title: Split PDF into Multiple Bulks by Page Ranges
split-pdf-into-multiple-page-ranges.description: Demonstrates how to split a PDF into separate files based on defined page ranges using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.SplitToBulks and save each bulk to disk.

split-pdf-into-multiple-bulks.title: Split PDF into Multiple Bulks Using MemoryStream
split-pdf-into-multiple-bulks.description: Shows how to split a PDF into defined page‑range bulks with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.SplitToBulks and process the resulting MemoryStream objects.

split-pdf-from-start-page-to-end.title: Split PDF from a Specific Page to End
split-pdf-from-start-page-to-end.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.SplitToEnd to extract pages from a given start page through the end of a PDF and save them as a new file.

split-pdf-from-start-page-to-end-using-s.title: Split PDF from a Start Page to End Using In-Memory Streams
split-pdf-from-start-page-to-end-using-s.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.SplitToEnd with input and output streams to split a PDF from a specified start page to the end, keeping the result in memory before optionally saving it.

split-pdf-into-page-streams.title: Split PDF into MemoryStreams per Page
split-pdf-into-page-streams.description: Demonstrates how to split a PDF into individual pages and store each page in a separate MemoryStream using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-pages-from-pdf-file-path.title: Delete Pages 2‑5 from PDF Using File‑Path Overload
delete-pages-from-pdf-file-path.description: Demonstrates how to remove specific pages (2 through 5) from a PDF file by using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor's file‑path overload of the Delete method.

delete-specific-pages-from-pdf.title: Delete Specific Pages from PDF
delete-specific-pages-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to remove selected pages from a PDF file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor and save the result to a new file.

remove-first-and-last-pages-from-pdf.title: Remove First and Last Pages from PDF
remove-first-and-last-pages-from-pdf.description: Shows how to delete the first and last pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor.Delete method with an integer array.

batch-delete-pages-from-multiple-pdfs.title: Batch Delete Specific Pages from PDFs
batch-delete-pages-from-multiple-pdfs.description: Shows how to iterate over PDF files in a directory, delete selected pages from each document using Aspose.Pdf, and save the modified files to an output folder.

validate-pdf-page-deletion.title: Delete a PDF Page and Verify Page Count
validate-pdf-page-deletion.description: Loads a PDF, records the original page count, deletes a specified page, saves the document, then reloads it to confirm the page count decreased by one.

concatenate-three-pdfs-into-one.title: Concatenate Multiple PDFs Using PdfFileEditor
concatenate-three-pdfs-into-one.description: Demonstrates merging three PDF files into a single document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor’s three‑argument Concatenate method, with temporary file handling.

merge-multiple-pdf-streams.title: Merge Multiple PDF Streams into a Single PDF
merge-multiple-pdf-streams.description: Shows how to combine an array of PDF input streams into one PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor.Concatenate method, including placeholder creation and stream positioning.

concatenate-two-pdfs-using-pdffileeditor.title: Merge Two PDFs Using PdfFileEditor Concatenate
concatenate-two-pdfs-using-pdffileeditor.description: Demonstrates how to combine two PDF files on disk into a single PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor’s two‑file Concatenate method.

concatenate-pdfs-from-memory-streams.title: Concatenate PDFs from Memory Streams to File
concatenate-pdfs-from-memory-streams.description: Shows how to load PDF files into memory streams and merge them directly into an output file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor without creating intermediate files.

batch-concatenate-pdfs.title: Batch Concatenate PDFs in a Folder
batch-concatenate-pdfs.description: Shows how to gather all PDF files from a directory and merge them into a single PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades PdfFileEditor.

concatenate-multiple-pdfs-measure-time.title: Concatenate Multiple PDFs and Measure Execution Time
concatenate-multiple-pdfs-measure-time.description: Demonstrates how to create several small PDFs in memory, concatenate them using Aspose.Pdf's stream overload, and measure the operation's execution time.

compare-pdf-concatenation-paths-streams.title: Compare PDF Concatenation via File Path and Stream Overloads
compare-pdf-concatenation-paths-streams.description: Shows how to merge multiple PDFs using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor with both file‑path and stream overloads, and measures the memory impact of each approach.

create-pdf-booklet.title: Create Booklet from PDF using Aspose.Pdf
create-pdf-booklet.description: Demonstrates how to generate a booklet PDF from an existing document using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor with default settings.

create-a5-booklet-from-pdf.title: Create Booklet PDF with A5 Page Size
create-a5-booklet-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to generate a booklet from an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor with the A5 page size overload.

create-booklet-with-custom-page-order.title: Create Booklet PDF with Left‑Hand Odd and Right‑Hand Even Pages
create-booklet-with-custom-page-order.description: Shows how to generate a booklet PDF by assigning odd-numbered pages to the left side and even-numbered pages to the right side using Aspose.Pdf.

create-booklet-pdf-custom-page-size.title: Create Booklet PDF with Custom Page Size from Stream
create-booklet-pdf-custom-page-size.description: Demonstrates how to generate a booklet from a PDF stream, set each page to a custom 5.5×8.5‑inch size, and save the result to disk using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-booklet-in-separate-folders.title: Create PDF Booklets and Save to Separate Directories
create-pdf-booklet-in-separate-folders.description: The example processes all PDF files in a folder, creates a booklet for each using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, and stores the resulting booklet in its own subdirectory under a specified output root.

delete-pages-and-create-booklet.title: Delete Pages and Create Booklet from PDF
delete-pages-and-create-booklet.description: Shows how to remove specific pages from a PDF document and then generate a booklet using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-pages-concatenate-pdfs.title: Delete PDF Pages and Concatenate with Another Document
delete-pages-concatenate-pdfs.description: Shows how to remove specific pages from a PDF and then merge the edited PDF with a second document using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-specific-pages-pdf-error-handling.title: Delete PDF Pages with File-Path Overload and Error Handling
delete-specific-pages-pdf-error-handling.description: Demonstrates how to delete specific pages from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor Delete method with the file‑path overload, including validation for missing input files and exception handling.

create-pdf-booklet-with-audit-log.title: Create Booklet PDF with Logging
create-pdf-booklet-with-audit-log.description: Shows how to merge multiple PDF files, reorder pages to form a booklet, and log each step to a text file for audit using Aspose.Pdf.

resize-pdf-to-letter-size.title: Resize PDF Pages to Letter Size
resize-pdf-to-letter-size.description: Shows how to load a PDF, change every page to US Letter dimensions (8.5" x 11"), and save the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.

resize-pdf-pages-to-8-5x11-using-stream.title: Resize PDF Pages to Custom Dimensions via Stream
resize-pdf-pages-to-8-5x11-using-stream.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF from a file stream, set each page's size to 8.5×11 inches, and save the result using Aspose.Pdf's stream overloads.

batch-resize-pdfs-to-a4.title: Batch Resize PDFs to A4
batch-resize-pdfs-to-a4.description: Shows how to iterate over PDF files in a folder, resize each page to A4 size using Aspose.Pdf, and save the resized documents to a target directory.

measure-pdf-resize-performance-path-vs-s.title: Resize PDF Pages and Compare File‑Path vs Stream Overloads
measure-pdf-resize-performance-path-vs-s.description: Loads a large PDF, resizes every page to A4 dimensions, and saves the result using both file‑path and stream overloads while measuring execution time to compare their performance.

create-2up-pdf-layout.title: Create 2‑up PDF Layout with PdfFileEditor
create-2up-pdf-layout.description: Demonstrates how to generate a 2‑up (two pages per sheet) PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.MakeNUp and save the result.

create-4up-pdf-with-pdffileeditor.title: Create 4‑up PDF Using Stream Overload
create-4up-pdf-with-pdffileeditor.description: Demonstrates applying a 4‑up (N‑up) layout to an existing PDF by using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.MakeNUp with stream parameters and saving the result in a memory stream.

nup-to-booklet-pdf.title: Create N‑up Layout and Convert to Booklet PDF
nup-to-booklet-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to generate a 2‑up (portrait) PDF using N‑up processing and then transform the result into a printable booklet with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

delete-pages-resize-pdf.title: Delete Pages and Resize PDF Document
delete-pages-resize-pdf.description: Shows how to remove specific pages from a PDF and then resize the remaining pages using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-pages-from-multiple-pdfs-in-paral.title: Remove Pages from Multiple PDFs in Parallel
remove-pages-from-multiple-pdfs-in-paral.description: Demonstrates how to delete specified pages from several PDF files concurrently using Aspose.Pdf and Parallel.ForEach, saving the trimmed PDFs to an output folder.

concatenate-pdfs-using-stream-overloads.title: Concatenate PDFs Using Streams
concatenate-pdfs-using-stream-overloads.description: Shows how to merge multiple PDF files into a single document by opening each file as a stream and using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.Concatenate.

pdffileeditor-delete-invalid-page-test.title: Test Delete Throws Exception for Out‑of‑Range Page Numbers
pdffileeditor-delete-invalid-page-test.description: Demonstrates an NUnit unit test that verifies Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor.Delete method throws an exception when a page number beyond the document length is requested.

create-booklet-pdf.title: Create Booklet PDF from Stream using Aspose.Pdf
create-booklet-pdf.description: Shows how to convert an input PDF stream into a booklet‑style PDF by using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.MakeBooklet and returning the result as a MemoryStream.

create-booklet-pdf-custom-page-order.title: Create Booklet PDF with Default Page Size
create-booklet-pdf-custom-page-order.description: Demonstrates how to generate a booklet PDF from an existing document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor's MakeBooklet method with the default page size.

validate-pdf-concatenation-page-order.title: Validate PDF Concatenation Preserves Page Order
validate-pdf-concatenation-page-order.description: Demonstrates concatenating multiple PDFs with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor and verifying that the merged document retains the original page sequence by checking page counts and order.

delete-specific-pages-from-pdfs.title: Delete Pages 3 and 4 from PDFs in a Folder
delete-specific-pages-from-pdfs.description: Loads each PDF from a source directory, removes pages 3 and 4 when they exist, and saves the modified files to an output directory using Aspose.Pdf.

concatenate-multiple-pdfs-with-logging.title: Merge Multiple PDFs with Step-by-Step Logging
concatenate-multiple-pdfs-with-logging.description: Shows how to sequentially concatenate several PDF files using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor while logging each input and output file name for every merge step.

create-booklet-pdf-left-odd-pages.title: Create Booklet PDF with Left Pages Odd Layout
create-booklet-pdf-left-odd-pages.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor to generate a booklet PDF where left pages are odd-numbered, and explains the version limitation that may require upgrading the library.

resize-pdf-streams-verify-tiff.title: Resize PDF Pages to Custom Dimensions Using Streams
resize-pdf-streams-verify-tiff.description: Shows how to load a PDF from a file stream, set each page size to 1024 × 768 points, save the result to a memory stream, and verify the new dimensions.

batch-delete-pages-merge-pdfs.title: Batch Delete Pages and Merge PDFs
batch-delete-pages-merge-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to remove specified pages from several PDF files and then concatenate the cleaned PDFs into a single document using Aspose.Pdf.

concatenate-multiple-pdfs.title: Merge Multiple PDFs into a Single Document
concatenate-multiple-pdfs.description: Shows how to concatenate several PDF files into one PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.

merge-pdfs-from-network-streams.title: Merge PDFs from URLs without Temporary Files
merge-pdfs-from-network-streams.description: Shows how to download PDF files as streams from HTTP URLs and merge them directly into a single PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, avoiding any intermediate file creation.

validate-makebooklet-null-pagesize.title: Test MakeBooklet Throws on Null PageSize
validate-makebooklet-null-pagesize.description: Creates a minimal PDF and calls a helper that validates the custom PageSize before invoking PdfFileEditor.MakeBooklet, showing that an ArgumentNullException is thrown when the PageSize argument is null.

delete-pdf-pages-get-size.title: Delete PDF Pages and Get Resulting File Size
delete-pdf-pages-get-size.description: Shows how to remove specified pages from a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, save the modified document to a temporary file, replace the original, and return the new file size in bytes.

concatenate-pdfs-with-blank-pages.title: Concatenate PDFs with Blank Pages Between Documents
concatenate-pdfs-with-blank-pages.description: Shows how to merge multiple PDF files and automatically insert a blank page between each document using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-resize-pdfs-to-a5-and-create-bookl.title: Resize PDFs to A5 and Create Booklet
batch-resize-pdfs-to-a5-and-create-bookl.description: Shows how to batch‑process PDF files by resizing each page to A5 size and then generating a booklet using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-pages-create-2up-pdf.title: Delete Pages and Apply 2‑up Layout to PDF
delete-pages-create-2up-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to remove selected pages from a PDF stream, then create a 2‑up (two‑pages‑per‑sheet) layout and write the result back to a stream using Aspose.Pdf.

concatenate-pdfs-preserve-metadata.title: Concatenate PDFs and Preserve Metadata
concatenate-pdfs-preserve-metadata.description: Shows how to merge multiple PDF files using PdfFileEditor and copy the original document metadata (author, title, subject, etc.) to the merged PDF.

create-booklet-pdf-delete-resize.title: Create Booklet PDF with Page Deletion and Resize
create-booklet-pdf-delete-resize.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a stream, deleting a specified page range, resizing all pages, and generating a booklet using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, returning the result as a MemoryStream.

create-verify-pdf-booklet-page-sizes.title: Create PDF Booklet with Custom Page Sizes
create-verify-pdf-booklet-page-sizes.description: Demonstrates generating PDFs with various custom page dimensions and converting them into booklet format using Aspose.Pdf.

concatenate-pdfs-in-zip.title: Concatenate PDFs from a ZIP Archive and Save Merged PDF Back into the Archive
concatenate-pdfs-in-zip.description: The example extracts all PDF files from a ZIP archive, merges them into a single PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, and writes the merged document back into the same archive as "merged.pdf".

delete-pdf-pages-cli.title: Delete Specific Pages from a PDF
delete-pdf-pages-cli.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, removing selected pages, and saving the modified document to a new file via a command‑line tool.

parallel-pdf-page-deletion.title: Parallel Deletion of PDF Pages
parallel-pdf-page-deletion.description: Demonstrates processing multiple PDF files concurrently and removing a specified page from each document using Aspose.Pdf.

resize-pdf-landscape-booklet.title: Resize PDF Pages to Landscape and Create Booklet
resize-pdf-landscape-booklet.description: The example loads a PDF, rotates any portrait pages to landscape orientation, saves the modified document, and then uses Aspose.Pdf.Facades to generate a booklet PDF.

test-pdffileeditor-concatenate-empty-str.title: Test PdfFileEditor Concatenate Throws on Empty Input
test-pdffileeditor-concatenate-empty-str.description: Demonstrates an NUnit unit test that verifies PdfFileEditor.Concatenate throws an ArgumentException when provided with an empty array of input streams.

resize-pdfs-create-booklet.title: Resize PDFs and Create a Booklet
resize-pdfs-create-booklet.description: Shows how to resize each page of multiple PDF files to a fixed 1024x768 size and then merge them into a single booklet PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-pages-from-pdfs.title: Delete Specified Pages from Multiple PDFs
delete-pages-from-pdfs.description: Demonstrates loading PDFs with Aspose.Pdf, removing selected pages, and saving the cleaned documents with a "_cleaned" suffix.

merge-pdfs-with-blank-separator-pages.title: Add Blank Separator Pages Between PDFs
merge-pdfs-with-blank-separator-pages.description: Shows how to create a temporary blank PDF page and insert it as a separator between multiple PDFs while concatenating them with Aspose.Pdf.

resize-and-concatenate-pdfs.title: Resize PDFs to 1024x768 and Concatenate
resize-and-concatenate-pdfs.description: Shows how to batch resize each page of multiple PDFs to 1024x768 points and then merge the resized files into a single PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-and-resize-pdf-pages.title: Delete and Resize PDF Pages
delete-and-resize-pdf-pages.description: Loads a PDF, removes the specified pages, resizes the remaining pages to new dimensions, and returns the modified document as a MemoryStream.

concatenate-pdfs-add-page-numbers.title: Concatenate PDFs and Add Page Numbers
concatenate-pdfs-add-page-numbers.description: Shows how to merge several PDF files into a single document and automatically insert sequential page numbers on each page using Aspose.Pdf.

create-left-half-booklet.title: Generate Left-Page Booklet from PDF
create-left-half-booklet.description: Shows how to extract even‑numbered (left) pages from the first half of a PDF, save them to a temporary document, and create a booklet using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

create-booklet-from-second-half.title: Generate Booklet from Second Half Right Pages
create-booklet-from-second-half.description: Demonstrates extracting the second half of a PDF, selecting only the odd‑numbered (right‑hand) pages, and saving them as a new booklet PDF using Aspose.Pdf and the Facades API.
